# omadafusion_gateway_acl_order (Resource)

Enforces the evaluation order of gateway ACL rules. The listed rules are moved to the top of the table in the given order; unlisted rules keep their relative order below them. Use one of these per site. Destroying it leaves the order as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Evaluate the narrow permit before the broad deny.
resource "omadafusion_gateway_acl_order" "this" {
  acl_ids = [
    omadafusion_gateway_acl.printer_scan_permit.id,
    omadafusion_gateway_acl.devices_to_staff_deny.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `acl_ids` (List of String) Gateway ACL IDs, first match first.

### Optional

- `site` (String) Site name or ID. Defaults to the provider `site`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Site ID.
